تقاربت (form VI)

# تَقَارَبْتَ (taqārabta) /ta.qaː.rab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَارَبَ (taqāraba)
# تَقَارَبْتِ (taqārabti) /ta.qaː.rab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَارَبَ (taqāraba)
# تَقَارَبَتْ (taqārabat) /ta.qaː.ra.bat/: third-person fem
